crew.overview: The commandant of Auschwitz, Rudolf Höss, and his wife Hedwig, strive to build a dream life for their family in a house and garden next to the camp.
crew.title: The Zone of Interest

crew.overview: During World War II, the US Army's only all-Black, all-women battalion takes on an impossible mission: sorting through a three-year backlog of 17 million pieces of mail that hadn't been delivered to American soldiers and finish within six months.
crew.title: The Six Triple Eight

details.biography: Lucas is an emerging writer-director within the screen industries with a professional background in visual effects. A keen interest in concepts revolving around the cyclical nature of humanity, life and the universe, his films are rooted in modern philosophy. Having developed an appreciation for classical storytelling and production, he aspires to further develop his voice by experimenting with psychological and political elements explored through different narratives.
details.name: Lucas Hanwell
